title: factioncore plugin
description: A plugin that add factions in Minecraft server
body:
New GUI System:

✅ Faction Main Menu (/f menu or /f gui) - Central hub to access all features
✅ Faction Info GUI - View detailed faction statistics and information
✅ Faction List GUI - Browse all factions with clickable entries
✅ Member Management GUI - Visually manage members (promote/demote/kick)
Key Features:
Interactive Menus - Click items instead of typing commands
Visual Feedback - See core HP, member count, money, claims at a glance
Efficient Management - Leaders can promote/demote/kick members with clicks
Cross-Version Compatible - Uses XSeries for materials (1.8 - 1.21.1+)
Plugin Features Summary:
✅ Create/disband/join/leave factions
✅ Chunk claiming system with costs
✅ Core Block System (1000 HP, damaged by TNT, faction becomes vulnerable when destroyed)
✅ Rank system (Leader, Officer, Member) with permissions
✅ Faction economy & banking
✅ Relations (Ally, Enemy, Neutral)
✅ Faction chat toggle
✅ Home/warp system with teleport delays
✅ Claim map visualization
✅ GUI-based management
✅ YAML data persistence
Usage:
Commands work as before: /f create, /f claim, etc.
NEW: /f menu opens the GUI for easier management!
